core.headline: New-build three-bedroom semi-detached house, Kings Hill
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house (The Larch) on a modern development in Kings Hill, West Malling, with completion expected spring 2027. The property benefits from an air source heat pump, underfloor heating to the ground floor, an EV charging point and a 10-year NHBC warranty. There is no onward chain.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). The first floor offers three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside there is a turfed rear garden with patio. Two allocated parking spaces are included, with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away.

Fixed Price £410,000. Freehold. Estate charge £295 per year. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. A reservation fee of £1,500 applies, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. A developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring is available for reservations by 30 November 2026. The final EPC will be issued on completion.
